patient._comment: 'patient' contains the three sections that may be exposed in the detailed patient display: presentation, answer, and clinical.

presentation._comment: Information available to the player before assigning a room. This is the only detailed-patient section exposed before the first assignment.
presentation.quote: The waiter swore there was no shrimp in the pad thai. Now my lips feel swollen, I can hear myself wheezing, and I feel like I might pass out.
presentation.triageNote: 27-year-old woman with diffuse hives and reported facial and lip swelling minutes after eating shellfish. She is wheezing and lightheaded, with a blood pressure of 88/54 and oxygen saturation of 90%.

answer._comment: The authoritative game answer. The player's assigned room is session state and is not stored in the patient record.

clinical._comment: Display-ready educational explanation of why the correct ESI applies, using only evidence in patient.presentation. Used by Coach and Patient Review after the answer is available; does not participate in scoring.
clinical.summary: This patient has airway and breathing compromise with hypotension after an allergen exposure and requires an immediate lifesaving intervention.
clinical.acuityReason: Wheeze, facial and lip swelling, oxygen saturation of 90%, blood pressure of 88/54, tachycardia, and lightheadedness indicate rapidly progressive respiratory and circulatory compromise.
expectedResources: IV access and rapid fluid resuscitation
clinical.destinationReason: ESI 1 / Resuscitation is required because epinephrine and hemodynamic support cannot safely be delayed.
keyFindings: Symptoms began within minutes of eating shellfish
Diffuse hives visible on the face, chest, and arms
redFlags: Rapid onset after a likely allergen exposure
teachingPoints: ESI 1 is assigned when an immediate lifesaving intervention is required, even if the patient is awake and speaking.
Intramuscular epinephrine is the priority intervention when allergic symptoms involve airway, breathing, or circulation.

possibleClinicalOutcome.disposition: The patient would receive immediate epinephrine, oxygen, IV fluids, airway readiness, and monitored observation, with admission or discharge determined by response and recurrence risk.

aiImageGeneration._comment: 'aiImageGeneration' is info for AI to generate the image of the patient. Most images were done with openAI gpt-image-1 using an API, not the app, in July 2026. Look for some python scripts that are used to create these images. Be sure that the anchor-image is available and is provided to the AI - otherwise the images will not be consistent.
aiImageGeneration.who: 27-year-old woman in a nice dinner outfit
aiImageGeneration.pose: sitting forward on a clinic chair, hand at her throat
signs: raised red hives on her neck and arms
aiImageGeneration.prompt: Softly-shaded painterly cartoon illustration in a semi-realistic Pixar/Disney style: smooth gradient shading, soft natural lighting, gentle rounded volumes, fine delicate outlines (NOT thick flat cartoon outlines), warm detailed rendering, natural realistic proportions, single character, 3/4 front view, centered, square 1:1. Match the exact painterly style, brushwork, shading, line weight, lighting, and palette of the attached reference image. Subject: an Asian 27-year-old woman in a nice dinner outfit, on the same blue clinic chair. Pose: sitting forward, one hand at her throat. Expression: wide-eyed alarm, struggling to breathe. Clearly visible: swollen lips and puffy face, raised red hives on her neck and arms. Overall acutely distressed with a threatened airway. No text, no logos.
